title: Sigma Models with Noncommutative Target Spaces
exact_target: Define fields and an action for sigma models whose target is a noncommutative space, beginning with irrational noncommutative tori.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001330 (OWR-4084-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Noncommutative Geometry (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/41, pp. 2271--2334; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 19--22, printed pages 2289--2292.

status_qualification: The report presents noncommutative replacements and example classification results. It does not make one proposed homomorphism framework a universal answer for all noncommutative targets, or identify every possible physical field with a classical map.
